spans.s: pṛthivī, cf. Prakrit sava-puṭhaviyaṃ (CII, Vol. I, p. 87, text line 7); used to indicate the dominions of the Maurya emperor Aśoka, versions other than Dhauli (Rock Edict V) having sarvatra vijite (i. e. ‘everywhere within the dominions’) in its place. Cf. Jambudvīpa.
pṛthvī-liṅga (SII 2), a Śivaliṅga made of earth.
